forecast.model: training-year mean by working-day, hour, and weather state

optimization.system_boundary: Four six-hour service blocks, one planning day, system-level demand, and a fixed homogeneous resource pool
optimization.decision_variables: integer units assigned to each time block
optimization.objective: mean unmet share + 0.5 × p90 unmet share on 2011
optimization.enumeration_justification: Four bounded integer variables yield a small finite feasible set of 6,545 allocations; every feasible point is checked.

value_of_perfect_information_upper_bound.boundary: Perfect foresight is an unattainable upper bound, not a forecast or the value of a purchasable information system.

uncertainty_decomposition.parameter_uncertainty: Day-block bootstrap of held-out policy metrics.
uncertainty_decomposition.operating_randomness: Observed day-to-day and wet-day demand variation in 2012.
uncertainty_decomposition.shared_shocks: Each bootstrap day is shared by every policy, preserving common weather and demand shocks across alternatives.

reversal_conditions: Unit capacity differs materially by block.
Labor, travel-time, or maintenance constraints invalidate feasibility.

provenance.citation: Fanaee-T, H. (2013). Bike Sharing [Dataset]. UCI Machine Learning Repository. https://doi.org/10.24432/C5W894
